displayName: Tier S — Elite Product & Quant (FAANG, Uber, Stripe, Tower)
description: Top 1% global product organizations, high-frequency trading firms, and foundational infra teams. Zero tolerance for shallow buzzwords; ruthless focus on algorithmic depth, distributed systems, scale, and high-agency engineering.
minimumSignals: Deep algorithmic competence (LeetCode/Codeforces/ACM-ICPC or strong DSA track record)
Concrete scale metrics (e.g. QPS, latency p99, GB/TB data, concurrent connections)
High ownership of core subsystems rather than peripheral plumbing
Rigorous understanding of operating systems, networking, concurrency, and memory
strongSignals: Recognized open-source contributions or authoring libraries
Candidate in top 5% on competitive programming platforms (Codeforces Candidate Master+, LeetCode 2100+)
Experience optimizing high-throughput distributed systems (Kafka, Cassandra, Raft, Paxos)
Clear metrics showing latency reduction (e.g. reduced p99 from 450ms to 85ms) or infrastructure cost savings at scale
Tier-1 education (IIT/NIT/BITS/Top Global) or equivalent proven exceptional engineering track record
redFlags: Listing 20+ technologies without depth or metrics in any project
Zero evidence of scale, performance testing, or quantitative outcomes
Purely tutorial-based projects (Netflix clone, Todo app) on experienced or senior resumes
Lack of low-level systems awareness or superficial copy-paste architectures
typicalScreeningCriteria: Rigorous coding/DSA screen (medium-hard DP, graphs, trees) in 45 minutes
Comprehensive System Design interview covering distributed caching, sharding, consensus, and fault tolerance
Deep behavioral probe into failure post-mortems and architecture trade-offs

fresher.expectations: Top tier DSA rating, CS fundamentals (OS, DBMS, CN), 2+ high-complexity projects or tier-1 internships

1-3.expectations: Production service ownership, automated CI/CD, measurable performance optimizations, clean API design

3-5.expectations: System design leadership, cross-service architecture, distributed databases, incident command, mentoring

5+.expectations: Multi-team technical direction, architecture decisions, reliability SLAs (99.99%), engineering organizational impact

displayName: Tier A — Well-Funded Product Scale-Ups & Unicorns (Swiggy, Razorpay, CRED, Stripe-scale)
description: Fast-paced, product-first scale-ups where shipping fast, high feature ownership, resilience under load, and product intuition dominate.
minimumSignals: Demonstrated end-to-end feature shipping from concept to production
Clear business or operational impact metrics (revenue, conversion, latency, user adoption)
Modern full-stack or backend stack proficiency (Go, Node.js, Python, React, PostgreSQL)
Proactive automated testing and CI/CD deployment experience
strongSignals: Zero-to-one product development or critical refactoring of legacy bottlenecks
Cross-functional collaboration with PMs, Designers, and Data Science
Hands-on containerization and cloud orchestration (Docker, K8s, AWS/GCP)
Experience handling traffic surges, flash sales, or async message queues
redFlags: Passive role descriptions ('worked on tickets', 'assisted in testing')
No understanding of deployment, containers, or production observability
Inability to explain why a particular tech stack or database was chosen over alternatives
typicalScreeningCriteria: Machine coding or practical take-home/pair-programming round building a production feature
Practical system architecture focusing on practical tradeoffs (Redis caching, queue worker idempotency)

fresher.expectations: Polished production-deployed full-stack projects, internship in a product startup, strong React/Node or Python skills

1-3.expectations: Independent delivery of major features, handling DB migrations, monitoring logs with Sentry/Datadog

3-5.expectations: Tech spec authoring, architecture refactoring, mentoring junior devs, capacity planning

5+.expectations: Domain architecture ownership, hiring interviewer, reliability driving, driving tech roadmaps

displayName: Tier B — Mid-Size Product & Established MNCs (Adobe, Cisco, SAP, Oracle, Amex)
description: Stable enterprise and mid-market product environments valuing solid engineering fundamentals, disciplined development lifecycles, and standard technology patterns.
minimumSignals: Consistent software development lifecycle experience (Agile/Scrum, Jira, PR reviews)
Solid core programming fundamentals in enterprise languages (Java, C#, Python, JavaScript)
Experience interacting with relational or document databases and writing clean queries
Relevant degree in Computer Science, IT, or proven software internships
strongSignals: Industry certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Oracle Java, etc.)
Experience with enterprise testing frameworks and code coverage (SonarQube, JUnit)
Multi-year tenure with demonstrated internal promotions or commendations
redFlags: Spelling errors in core frameworks or messy resume formatting
Gaps in work history without contextual explanation
Lack of version control (Git) workflow awareness
typicalScreeningCriteria: Standard technical screening (data structures, language quirks, OOP concepts)
Architecture discussion on design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer) and basic DB design
Managerial round on team fit and process adherence

fresher.expectations: Good academic record (7.0+ CGPA), strong OOP concepts, academic capstone projects, basic Git and SQL

1-3.expectations: Bug fixing, feature enhancements within existing architecture, unit test writing, sprint participation

3-5.expectations: Module ownership, code reviewing, technical documentation, third-party API integration

5+.expectations: Module lead, client or stakeholder communication, legacy modernization, technical onboarding

displayName: Tier C — Global IT Services & Mass Recruiters (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture)
description: Large-scale consulting and IT services handling enterprise client contracts, support, and outsourced application maintenance. Strict screening criteria based on qualification cutoffs, certifications, and project counts.
minimumSignals: Bachelor's degree in engineering/computer applications with standard cutoff (60%+ / 6.5+ CGPA)
Familiarity with fundamental software development concepts (SDLC, SQL, Core Java or .NET)
Flexibility with tech stack and project deployment
strongSignals: Recognized cloud or vendor certifications (Azure Fundamentals, AWS Cloud Practitioner)
Diverse project portfolio showing willingness to learn new stacks
Experience with client communications or ITIL support workflows
redFlags: Inconsistent dates or suspicious academic histories
Complete inability to articulate personal project code or logic
Unformatted resume that breaks ATS resume scanners
typicalScreeningCriteria: Aptitude, logical reasoning, and verbal assessment
Fundamental coding test (basic loops, strings, array manipulation)

fresher.expectations: Passed academic cutoffs, basic programming syntax, completed training courses or final year project

1-3.expectations: Ticket resolution, basic code changes, bug fixing, test case execution, daily standups

3-5.expectations: Team lead for module, direct client interactions, SLA compliance, code reviews

5+.expectations: Delivery lead, project management, customer escalations, vendor certifications
